flutter_method_applicability.applicability_status: conditional preliminary base-panel screen; installed root and low-aspect-ratio limitations are unresolved
flutter_method_applicability.aspect_ratio_domain_note: This one-panel aspect ratio is low; Martin/NACA TN 4197 notes its underlying bending-torsion relation is stretched when extended to low-aspect-ratio wings. It remains an empirical preliminary screen, with no chart-boundary pass inference.
flutter_method_applicability.candidate_source_method: NACA TN 4197 (Martin, 1958), Eq. 18 cantilever fin bending-torsion screen
flutter_method_applicability.geometric_domain_status: base plate matches constant-chord/constant-thickness-ratio geometry; root stiffness still requires installed-joint correction
limitations: The screen is conditional and empirical, not an installed fin/body aeroelastic analysis.
Finite root bond, plywood/frame support flexibility, torsional joint stiffness and damping remain unmeasured.
Low panel aspect ratio limits confidence in extending the bending-torsion relation.
The fresh simulated speed is a comparison bound only; it does not establish a flight envelope.

numerical_screen.scope_note: The source's constant-chord/constant-thickness base-panel geometry applies to this unswept rectangular fin. Root/gusset variation is local; installed root rotational/torsional stiffness, damping, body coupling, aeroelastic modes and flight validation remain unresolved.
numerical_screen.source_method: Existing WO-03 vibration implementation of Martin/NACA TN 4197 Eq. 18, evaluated on the minimum-thickness rectangular unswept base panel with current study material ranges.

flutter_method_applicability.source_applicability: conditional empirical panel screen; requires geometry matching the source assumptions, a defensible installed stiffness model, and a current vehicle speed/q bound
flutter_method_applicability.source_module_legacy_taper_note_excluded: The generic vibration helper includes a tapered-panel caveat; the current resolved fin is rectangular and constant-chord, so the geometry-specific domain assessment above supersedes that caveat.
flutter_method_applicability.speed_bound_source: not supplied to this geometry-only assessment; attach fresh flight-record metrics before comparing a screen speed
